title: Security Check
description: An atomic, safe, evidence-producing security test that an agent executes against Azure resources.

mode.description: Minimum operating mode required to run this check. 'active' checks send real traffic to live endpoints and only run under engagement mode external-active-testing with an enabled, authorized external_testing block. 'cluster-active' checks reach into a live Kubernetes cluster or container (kube-bench, kubesec, trivy/grype, kubectl exec/debug) and only run under engagement mode cluster-active-testing with an enabled, authorized cluster_testing block.

tier.description: Minimum intensity tier required to run this check. external-vuln (EVA) tiers: safe-active, active-dast, exploit-validation, static-analysis. container (aks-container) cluster-active tiers: cluster-benchmark (kube-bench/kubesec/auth-can-i, API reads only), image-scan (offline trivy/grype over pulled images), runtime-probe (benign read-only inventory inside a running pod via ephemeral debug container).

method.description: How the check gathers data. http-probe/dast/static-analysis are EVA (external-vuln) methods that operate against the Azure-derived target allowlist. kube-api is a read-only Kubernetes API read (kubectl get/describe/auth can-i). container-scan is a gated cluster-active scan (kube-bench/kubesec/trivy/grype or benign in-pod inventory) against the Azure-derived cluster allowlist.

logic.description: The condition that constitutes a failing finding

nist_csf.description: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 subcategory IDs, e.g. ['PR.AA-01', 'DE.CM-09']. See controls/nist-csf.yaml.
